papers.authors: Hongzhan Yu, Chenghao Li, Ruipeng Zhang, Henrik Christensen, Sicun Gao
papers.evidence: 面向安全机器人操作的分布外检测
papers.tldr: 生成式动力学模型在机器人规划中易受分布外转移影响，现有事后检测方法在动力学对关键动作不敏感时失效。本文提出支持条件控制敏感性正则化，在高支持区域增强模型对控制输入的敏感响应，保留控制变化同时抑制不稳定外推。在视觉避障、操作和真实导航实验中，该方法提升了OOD检测性能和闭环安全性。贡献在于揭示了潜在建模中敏感性缺失导致的OOD检测缺陷，并提供了有效的正则化解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generative dynamics models enable planning in challenging robotic systems, but safe deployment requires reliably detecting policy-induced out-of-distribution (OOD) transitions. Existing methods typically treat the learned dynamics as fixed and attach post hoc support surrogates. We show that these surrogates can fail when the dynamics are locally insensitive to critical action choices: unsupported control actions may produce latent predictions that resemble demonstrated transitions, suppressing OOD signals despite large true predictive errors. To address this, we introduce support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization, which promotes sensitive local response to control input changes in learned dynamics in high-support training regions. This preserves control-induced variation while limiting unstable extrapolation due to weak empirical support. Experiments in vision-based obstacle avoidance, manipulation, and real-robot navigation show improved OOD detection and safer closed-loop planning.

papers.title_en: EgoPriMo: Egocentric Motion Generation for Interactive Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Haoyang Ge, Peng Ren, Yukun Shi, Cong Huang, Kun Li, Kai Chen
papers.evidence: 从第一人称人类演示学习运动先验，支持人形机器人数据集构建
papers.tldr: 人形机器人需要适应场景和任务的全身运动，但现有方法缺乏可扩展的交互式先验。EgoPriMo从第一视角人类演示学习运动先验，使用三流扩散Transformer联合建模身体动态、视觉和文本。单一模型在运动生成上超越UniEgoMotion，同时支持重建和预测，且生成的SMPL运动可直接驱动机器人。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots require whole-body motions that adapt to scene context, task requirements, and user intent. Motion tracking reproduces specified trajectories, and humanoid vision-language-action systems provide semantic interfaces, but neither offers a scalable and interactive prior for broad full-body behavior. We introduce EgoPriMo (Egocentric Motion Prior for Humanoid Robots), a unified framework that learns such priors from egocentric human demonstrations. Given egocentric observations and a text prompt, EgoPriMo reconstructs, generates, and forecasts SMPL-based full-body motion. Language is used as a high-level control signal rather than a complete motion specification. At the core of EgoPriMo is a Triple-stream DiT that jointly models body dynamics, egocentric visual context, and text; task-conditioning masks route different tasks and missing-modality data through the same checkpoint. Experiments on Nymeria and EgoExo4D show that one checkpoint improves egocentric motion generation over UniEgoMotion while supporting reconstruction and forecasting; the generated SMPL motions can also be executed by a Unitree humanoid controller. These results indicate a practical path from scalable egocentric observations to generalizable and interactive humanoid motion priors.

papers.title_en: D2H-AD: A Hybrid Model Utilizing Hyperdimensional Computing for Advanced Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Ghazal Ghajari, Elaheh Ghajari, Ashutosh Ghimire, Saeid Ataei, Faris Alsulami, Fathi Amsaad
papers.evidence: 基于超维度计算的异常检测方法，适用于边缘部署
papers.tldr: 针对传统异常检测方法依赖大量标注数据、计算成本高且难以扩展至边缘设备的问题，提出D2H-AD框架，基于超维计算（HDC）整合距离相似性和密度感知编码。消融实验表明超维编码相比原始特征空间直接打分ROC-AUC提升5.4%。在五个基准数据集上，D2H-AD在F1分数和ROC-AUC上全面优于HDAD、ODHD、单类SVM、孤立森林和自编码器五个基线。该框架轻量、可解释、计算高效，支持二进制运算，适用于TinyML和边缘AI部署。
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is a fundamental component of intelligent systems with applications in healthcare, cybersecurity, smart grids, and IoT environments. Although conventional machine learning and deep learning methods have demonstrated effectiveness in identifying anomalies, they often rely on large labeled datasets, incur high computational costs, and face scalability challenges in edge and high-dimensional settings. This paper presents D2H-AD, a novel anomaly detection framework based on Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC), a brain-inspired paradigm that represents information using high-dimensional distributed vectors. Unlike existing HDC-based methods, D2H-AD integrates distance-based similarity and density-aware encoding within a unified framework, improving anomaly representation and detection performance. Ablation studies show that hyperdimensional encoding alone yields up to 5.4% higher ROC-AUC than applying the same density-distance scoring directly in the original feature space. Furthermore, D2H-AD consistently outperforms five established baselines, namely HDAD, ODHD, One-Class SVM, Isolation Forest, and Autoencoders, across all evaluated datasets. The framework is lightweight, interpretable, and computationally efficient, making it suitable for resource-constrained and real-time applications. We validate D2H-AD on five benchmark datasets and demonstrate superior F1-score and ROC-AUC performance, together with robustness to class imbalance, noise, and data complexity. In addition to improved accuracy, D2H-AD offers scalability, a small memory footprint, and low-latency operation enabled by binary computations and a compact design. These properties make it particularly attractive for TinyML and edge AI deployments. The proposed framework highlights the potential of HDC for accurate, interpretable, and energy-efficient anomaly detection in dynamic environments.

papers.title_en: Kine2Go: Kinematic dataset for the Unitree Go2 robot with diverse gaits and motions
papers.authors: Władysław Pałucki, Paweł Siwak, Krzysztof Ciebiera, Marek Cygan
papers.evidence: 为宇树机器人（Go2）构建运动学数据集，直接关联宇树数据集构建
papers.tldr: Unitree Go2四足机器人被广泛用于运动控制研究，但获取演示数据需要复杂的流程。Kine2Go数据集提供了800条基于40种不同策略生成的Go2运动轨迹，包含运动学信息和电机动作。通过强化学习将不同形态四足机器人的动作迁移到Go2上，得到鲁棒的扰动数据。该数据集降低了获取高质量演示数据的门槛，支持模仿学习等研究。
papers.abstract_en: The recent popularity of robotics, combined with the steadily decreasing cost of robotic hardware, has lowered the entry barrier to robotics research and enabled rapid advancements in the field. One of the primary examples is the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, which is often used by researchers in the areas of locomotion, navigation, control, and others. Many researchers use the Go2 robot in combination with techniques like imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and behavioral cloning to allow machine learning systems to take full control of the robot. At the same time, many of those techniques require demonstration data consisting of the robot's kinematics information and actions applied to the motors. Obtaining such data is difficult, requires building complex pipelines, and can take significant time. To aid in those kinds of efforts, we present Kine2Go - a dataset with 800 diverse gait kinematics trajectory motion data for the Unitree Go2 robot, derived from 40 distinct policies. Our pipeline accepts data from various quadruped morphologies and translates them to a Go2-compatible format. Then we use Reinforcement Learning to train policies following a given motion, and finally we gather data from those policies, which grants robust, perturbed kinematic data with corresponding motor-level actions.

papers.title_en: Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids
papers.authors: Xiao Ren, Yuhui Yang, Zongbiao Weng, Zhijie Liu, He Kong
papers.evidence: 人形机器人跌倒恢复与运动跟踪的统一框架
papers.tldr: 针对现有强化学习框架将人形机器人的运动跟踪与跌倒恢复作为独立任务、需多阶段训练且缺乏恢复探索的问题，提出Stubborn统一框架。采用偏航对齐跟踪表示减少全局漂移敏感度，引入伯努利概率终止机制和跟踪误差驱动采样策略，激励跌倒恢复探索并提升困难样本训练效率。在多个基准任务上超越现有方法，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。该框架为人形机器人鲁棒运动控制提供了统一高效的解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. First, a yaw-aligned tracking representation is adopted to reduce sensitivity to global drift and heading disturbances while preserving gravity-related balance information. Second, we introduce a Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination mechanism that enables the policy to encourage exploration of fall-recovery behaviors under varying failure modes. Third, we propose a probabilistic termination and tracking-error-driven strategy that dynamically reshapes the sampling distribution based on tracking performance, increasing the training efficiency for difficult motion segments and unstable states. Extensive comparisons with SOTA methods and ablation studies show that Stubborn achieved competitive performance, and the proposed probabilistic termination mechanism and adaptive sampling strategy contributed to the performance and robustness gains. For real-world demonstrations, please refer to https://aislab-sustech.github.io/Stubborn/.

papers.title_en: GAIT: Legged Robot Proprioceptive State Estimation with Attention over Inertial-Leg Tokens
papers.authors: Young-Rang Seo, Hajun Kim, Sangmin Kim, Dongyun Kang, Hae-Won Park
papers.evidence: 基于本体感受信号的人形机器人故障诊断
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人状态估计中，传感器融合面临接触条件变化导致的运动学可靠性差异。本文提出GAIT，将IMU和腿部测量作为独立令牌，通过注意力机制动态学习各传感器权重，无需显式接触估计器。在Unitree Go1机器人上，对未见步态和碎石地形的测试表明，该方法精度优于现有学习方法和接触辅助模型估计器。贡献在于自适应传感器加权机制提升了状态估计鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a method that applies Inertial-Leg (IL) tokenization to an attention-based network for proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots. Unlike existing learning-based state estimators that concatenate all sensor measurements into a single flat vector, the proposed architecture represents inertial measurements and leg-wise measurements as individual tokens and uses an attention mechanism to learn the relative importance of each measurement.This design allows the network to reweight each measurement according to the current contact condition, reflecting the fact that the reliability of forward kinematic measurements depends on whether the corresponding foot is in contact. Unlike conventional contact-aided estimators, however, the proposed method learns this behavior without relying on an explicit contact estimator or on explicit measurement updates based on a stationary contact assumption. To validate the proposed method, we conducted experiments on a Unitree Go1 robot, including debris terrain not modeled in simulation and gait patterns not seen during training. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better estimation performance than existing learning-based state estimators under unseen gait patterns and also improves performance over contact-aided model-based methods.

papers.title_en: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
papers.authors: He Zhang, Lingzhu Xiang, Haitao Lin, Zeyu Huang, Minghui Wang, Dingyan Zhong, Yubo Dong, Yihao Wu, Yongming Rao, Dongsheng Zhang, Wanjia He, Ling Chen, Kai Huang, Jiahao Chen, Sichang Su, Xumin Yu, Ziyi Wang, Chengwei Zhu, Xiao Teng, Yuchun Guo, Yufeng Zhang, Yuandong Liu, Rui Wang, Zisheng Lu, Han Hu, Zhengyou Zhang
papers.evidence: 涵盖数据收集的完整机器人学习栈
papers.tldr: 机器人学习面临从数据到部署各环节割裂的挑战。本文提出HyVLA-0.5，一个端到端系统，覆盖数据收集、模型设计、持续预训练与监督微调、强化学习后训练及真实环境部署。通过组件协同，系统在多种任务上实现高效学习与泛化，为机器人学习提供了一个可复现的全栈解决方案，降低了实际应用门槛。
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we present Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA, abbreviated as HyVLA-0.5, an end-to-end system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Each component serves a distinct role in this stack.

papers.title_en: EgoGuide: Egocentric Guidance for Efficient Robot-Free Demonstration Collection and Learning
papers.authors: Yue Xu, Mingtao Nie, Tianle Li, Hong Li, Yibo Luo, Siyuan Huang, Yong-Lu Li
papers.evidence: 通过自我中心引导的机器人数据集构建
papers.tldr: 机器人从真实演示学习受限于数据规模，现有UMI-style方法采集冗余且缺乏全局场景上下文。本文提出EgoGuide，通过同步腕部和自我中心观测并在线视觉-几何质量引导，结合门控自我中心残差策略，从视角变化的自我中心相机中鲁棒学习。真实实验表明，EgoGuide减少所需演示数量，提高数据效率，残差策略进一步增强了视觉遮挡下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning from real-world demonstrations is currently constrained by data scaling. Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) provides an efficient robot-free data collection interface, yet current UMI-style pipelines often collect redundant demonstrations and lack global scene context. To improve data efficiency, we present EgoGuide, a collection interface that records synchronized wrist and head/egocentric observations and couples them with online visual-geometric data quality guidance. We also introduce a Gated Egocentric Residual Policy for robust learning from a viewpoint-varying egocentric camera, allowing head/egocentric context to correct ambiguous local observations while preserving stable wrist-view control. Real-world experiments show that EgoGuide reduces the required number of data episodes and improves data efficiency. The residual policy further improves robustness under visual occlusion. Project Page: https://silicx.github.io/EgoGuide
